vllm/no_access_log.label: no per-request access-log line (minfer and SGLang write none)

vllm/xxhash.label: prefix-cache block hashes with xxHash instead of SHA-256

vllm/interactivity.label: performance mode 'interactivity' (fine-grained CUDA graphs, latency kernels)

sglang/lpm.label: longest-prefix-match scheduling (the default here is fcfs)

sglang/batch_tokenizer.label: dynamic batch tokenizer for concurrent requests

sglang/mixed_chunk.label: prefill and decode mixed in one batch

sglang/torch_compile.label: torch.compile for the model (documented for small models; experimental)

minfer/token_ids.label: minfer at its defaults, prompts sent as token ids

vllm/token_ids.label: vLLM at its defaults, prompts sent as token ids

sglang/token_ids.label: SGLang at its defaults, prompts sent as token ids

vllm/tuned.label: the flags the matrix uses for vLLM

sglang/tuned.label: the flags the matrix uses for SGLang
